_comment: The test inbox accounts (made-up, same schema as config/inbox-accounts.example.json). tests/*.py point BROKER_INBOX_ACCOUNTS here.

owner.posture: - Mail to the fleet@example.test alias is fleet mail, not the operator's own: forward it to admin-bot@chat.example.test as pending operator confirm and archive it. Never delete anything.

work.posture: - would-archive-only: log what you would archive, change nothing, until this account earns a track record.

alt.posture: - Backlog cap ~60 days: older unread mail is archived, never deleted.
